data.name: NGC-404: Fractured Sector
data.detailed_description:
✅ NGC-404 is for you if you:

  • Enjoy space strategy games with economy, fleets, colonies, and faction conflict

  • Like games where logistics, fuel and supplies matter

  • Want real-time 2D space battles with ship fitting and weapon control

  • Enjoy sandbox campaigns

  • Like managing a small fleet instead of controlling hundreds of units directly

  • Want to explore unknown systems, survey planets, and recover rare artifacts

  • Are interested in Early Access games that grow through player feedback

❌ NGC-404 may NOT be for you if you:

  • Expect a finished full-release game with all planned content already complete

  • Want a fast arcade space shooter focused only on direct action

  • Prefer fully scripted story campaigns over sandbox systems

  • Dislike economy, logistics, fuel, supplies, or resource management

  • Expect massive fleets with hundreds of directly controlled ships

  • Need highly polished UI and final balance from day one of Early Access

  • Are looking for a game without long-term strategic planning

NGC-404

A living 2D space strategy/RPG game about survival, trade, war, and building power in a sector.

The sector has been cut off from its home world.

Trade routes have collapsed. Colonies are running out of supplies. Factions compete for fuel, food, weapons, territory, and influence. In the middle of this crisis, you command a small fleet and try to turn it into something that can survive.

In NGC-404, you lead a faction in a simulated galaxy where economy, logistics, exploration, and combat are connected. Build colonies, fit ships, manage captains, trade resources, raid enemies, defend supply lines and fight real-time 2D battles where positioning and preparation matter as much as firepower.

Start small. Build influence. Shape the sector.

You begin with limited ships, limited resources and a dangerous sector around you. Every system can become an opportunity, a threat or a battlefield.

  • Command a small amount of ships directly

  • Explore star systems and unknown signals

  • Survey planets and decide where to expand

  • Build and develop colonies

  • Trade, raid, defend or conquer depending on your strategy

A living sector economy

The galaxy is not just a background map. Planets produce resources, colonies consume goods, shortages create pressure and trade routes determine which worlds survive and which begin to collapse.

  • Planets produce and consume resources over time

  • Supply and demand dynamically affect prices

  • Shortages can destabilize local and global markets

  • Surpluses can crash prices and create new opportunities

A powerful fleet is useless if it cannot be supplied. Fuel, supplies, production and trade access all matter when planning your next move.

Fit ships for your strategy

Your ships are not just health bars with guns. Their equipment, weapon groups, captains, hull quality and logistical limits affect how they perform in battle and how far they can operate from friendly territory.

  • Install weapons, systems, and ship components

  • Configure weapon groups and firing behavior

  • Hire characters and assign them as ship captains

  • Upgrade ships with better components and hull quality

  • Prepare different loadouts for different roles

Tactical 2D space battles

Combat in NGC-404 is real-time and logistics-driven. Ships use energy weapons, kinetic cannons, missiles, and point-defense systems. Positioning, firing arcs, range, fuel, supply and weapon control all affect the outcome of a fight.

  • Fight real-time 2D space battles

  • Use kinetic cannons, energy weapons, missiles, and point-defense

  • Intercept incoming projectiles with dedicated defensive weapons

  • Manage power, weapon groups, and firing control

  • Plan around fuel, supplies, damage, and recovery time

Battles are not isolated events. A victory can leave your fleet damaged, low on supplies, or unable to continue without support.

Explore the uncharted sector

The sector is only partially charted. Beyond established space, you can discover new systems, resource-rich planets, abandoned infrastructure, hidden signals and rare artifacts that can shift the balance of power.

  • Explore procedurally generated star systems

  • Survey planets for colonization potential

  • Discover derelict stations and abandoned infrastructure

  • Investigate hidden signals and unknown contacts

  • Recover artifacts that provide strategic advantages

Sensors, detection, and hidden threats

You do not always know what is out there. NGC-404 uses a dynamic sensor and detection system that determines what your ships can see, what remains unidentified and when hostile forces are finally revealed.

  • Detection ranges depend on ship capabilities

  • Unknown contacts can appear before they are identified

  • Hostile forces may remain hidden outside sensor coverage

  • Scouting and positioning can decide whether you control the engagement

Procedural sectors with shareable seeds

NGC-404 uses procedural generation with customizable seeds, allowing you to create a unique sector layout every time or share a specific sector with other players.

  • Randomized star systems and planetary distribution

  • Dynamic faction starting positions

  • Variable resource density and economic balance

  • Different exploration opportunities in every campaign

Solo or multiplayer sector campaigns

Play alone or shape the sector together. NGC-404 supports multiplayer, allowing players to control separate factions within the same simulated galaxy.

  • Control separate factions in one sector

  • Compete economically or form alliances

  • Wage wars over colonies, systems, and trade routes

  • Join ongoing campaigns with hot join support

Whether you cooperate or compete, the sector continues to evolve around the choices made by you and other players.

Core features

  • Living simulated galaxy with economy, trade, factions, and conflict

  • Small-fleet command with tactical real-time 2D combat

  • Colony building, resource production, and supply chains

  • Ship fitting, captains, weapon groups, and component upgrades

  • Exploration, surveying, hidden contacts, and ancient artifacts

  • Procedural sector generation with customizable seeds

  • Solo and multiplayer campaigns with hot join support

data.short_description: Lead a small fleet in a cut-off 2D space sector where trade, colonies, fuel, supplies and battles decide who survives. Build your faction, explore unknown systems, develop colonies, fit ships and shape a living simulated galaxy alone or with friends.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics card supporting Vulkan 1.0 (e.g. Intel HD 520) or equivalent with 1 GB VRAM.
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics card with Vulkan support (e.g. GTX 1060 / RX 580 or better)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
